knowledge_rules: UNVERIFIED (invented): Grade A (Mint / Like New): No visible wear at arm's length. OEM parts, no cracks, no repair markings, clean serials.
UNVERIFIED (invented): Grade B (Very Good): OEM parts, no cracks anywhere, light micro-scratches visible on close inspection only. Fully functional.

UNVERIFIED (invented): Grade C (Fair / Working Cracked Glass): CRACKED FRONT GLASS IS ALLOWED at Grade C as long as the display panel (LCD/OLED) underneath is healthy (full touch response, no dead pixels, at most one small spot, no burn-in). Must be OEM. NEVER auto-fail a cracked-but-functional screen to F.

UNVERIFIED (invented): Grade D (Bad Screen / Heavy Wear): Needs a new screen — touch digitizer failure, dead spots, visible burn-in, OR aftermarket screen (aftermarket panel is an automatic D regardless of appearance). Also applies to heavy frame gouges.

UNVERIFIED (invented): Grade F (DOA / Parts Only): No power / no sign of life, liquid corrosion/water damage indicator tripped, heavy frame bend, missing internal components, or shattered/black unreadable screen.
UNVERIFIED (invented): Battery Health Cutoff: Battery health under 80% triggers Apple 'Service' state and caps overall device grade at Grade C.

UNVERIFIED (invented): True Tone One-Way Rule: Absence of True Tone is an authenticity red flag (indicates unprogrammed aftermarket display); PRESENCE of True Tone proves nothing because EEPROM chip transfer between screens is standard repair shop practice.
UNVERIFIED (invented): Face ID / Biometric Defect: Broken or failing Face ID/Touch ID is a hardware component fault — reroutes device off the standard resale ladder to Parts tier.

UNVERIFIED (invented): IMEI Blacklist / Finance Status: Clean (White) IMEI permitted for standard wholesale resale. Financed (unpaid balance) or Blacklisted (lost/stolen) requires explicit disclosure and wholesale quarantine.
